description: Performance budgets enforced by perf and integration smoke tests. The inline assertion in each test is the source of truth; this file is the human-readable index. Update both together when a budget changes.

budgets.name: extractResetTimestamp — 1MB adversarial buffer
budgets.rationale: Feature 027 SC-007 — guards against catastrophic regex backtracking

budgets.name: extractResetTimestamp — 10MB adversarial buffer
budgets.rationale: Feature 027 SC-007 — same guard at 10x the input size

budgets.name: activity-feed render — 100KB manifest
budgets.rationale: Feature 029 — keeps the manifest -> rendered activity feed pipeline interactive

budgets.name: loadCatalog — p95 with many phases/pipelines
budgets.rationale: Feature 026 — catalog load must stay fast even with the operator-extended catalog

budgets.name: StateProjector — 100 v2 project() passes total
budgets.rationale: Snapshot render hot-path total budget over 100 simulated push cycles

budgets.name: StateProjector — single project() median
budgets.rationale: Snapshot render hot-path per-frame budget (60 fps target)

budgets.name: Extension activation via workspaceContains:.specify/
budgets.rationale: Release smoke for startup responsiveness before the sidebar is revealed

budgets.name: Sustained runner retained bytes per stream
budgets.rationale: Keeps stdout and stderr parser memory bounded independently while raw capture remains complete. Raised from 4 MiB on 2026-08-16 after a single planning phase emitted 4.8 MiB and was failed on output volume; the classification amplifier that made the old number a memory constraint was removed from stream-json-unwrapper.ts in the same change

budgets.name: Large phase-log hydrated entry cap
budgets.rationale: Bounds projected phase-log state while retaining the newest ordered entries

budgets.name: project() at the PERMITTED queue scale — 20 queues x 100 pending = 2,000 items
budgets.rationale: FR-R3-114 row 1 — every other render case measured 25 items while the product permits 2,000 (MAX_QUEUES x 100). Measured 2026-08-27 on darwin/arm64: 649.8 ms total for 100 passes, median 6.39 ms. Budget is ~3x the measurement: headroom for a loaded machine, tight enough to catch an order-of-magnitude regression. Companion median budget PERMITTED_SCALE_MEDIAN_BUDGET_MS = 20 ms.

budgets.name: compareTrees groups 15,000 unrelated findings of one package
budgets.rationale: FR-R4-F21 (feature 249): a capture is an unsigned file, so its finding count is untrusted and bounded only by the 16 MiB capture size. Measured 2026-10-30 on darwin/arm64 (macOS 27.0.1, Node 24.19.0) under a load average of 54: the linear grouping took 56 to 167 ms over 7 samples, median 105 ms; the quadratic grouping it replaced took 7.1 s. The budget is at least 5x the slowest linear sample and at most a seventh of the quadratic time.

budgets.name: compareTrees classifies a base finding with 15,000 locations and versions
budgets.rationale: FR-R4-F21 (feature 249): the location count of one finding is untrusted and bounded only by the 16 MiB capture size. Measured 2026-10-30 on darwin/arm64 (macOS 27.0.1, Node 24.19.0) under a load average of 54: the linear classification took 17 to 54 ms over 7 samples, median 25 ms; the quadratic one it replaced took 25.5 s. The budget is at least 18x the slowest linear sample and at most a twenty-fifth of the quadratic time.

budgets.name: process-YAML scanner: cost of each doubling of a hostile run of spaces (5k, 10k, 20k), six shapes
budgets.rationale: FR-R4-F07 (feature 254) S-T1, SC-001: the gated value is a ratio, not a time. Linear work doubles per doubling and quadratic work quadruples, so 3.0 separates them on any machine. Measured 2026-10-31 on darwin/arm64 (Node 24.19.0), load average about 3: before the trims were linearized the ratios were 3.97 to 4.01 on shapes 1, 4 and 6 (561.96 ms, 1,123.84 ms and 562.26 ms per scan at 20k spaces); after, every ratio was 1.36 to 1.99. The 20k medians are recorded and not asserted: 0.41 ms (shape 1), 0.04 ms (shape 4), against SC-001's target of under 50 ms. The same harness over the old regexes (kept in the test as an oracle) must show a ratio above 3.0 at 2.5k, 5k and 10k spaces, which proves the gate can see quadratic growth.

budgets.name: findLocalSecrets — 1 MiB near-match run per family
budgets.rationale: FR-R4-F10 SC2: the scanner's local rule stays linear. One 1,048,576-unit run of near-matches per family, from fixed seeds, is read in under 250 ms (the median of 7, with one retake).

budgets.name: SanitizedLogger.sanitize — one call at the 1,048,576-unit line bound, per hostile generator
budgets.rationale: FR-R4-F10 SC-005: the line sinks admit a line of DEFAULT_MAX_LINE_UNITS (1,048,576), and one sanitize() call over it must stay under 250 ms (median of 7, one retake), with a full-over-half ratio of at most 3.0. Measured at plan on darwin/arm64 (Node 24.19.0): the worst linear generator took 8.7 ms at 1 MiB; the JWT expression took 10.8 s at 128 Ki and the GCP envelope 1.85 s at 1 MiB. The pre-change JWT expression is kept in the test as an oracle that must show a ratio above 3.0.

budgets.name: SanitizedLogger.sanitize — one call at the 16 MiB artifact bound, for G1 eyJ, G2 and G8
budgets.rationale: FR-R4-F10 SC-005: evidence export and the diagnostics bundle sanitize a whole artifact of up to MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES (16 MiB) in one call (research R14). One sample per generator, which keeps the tier's added time under a minute.

budgets.name: parseAuditLogBlock + parseInvocation — completion detection at 16 MiB, five hostile shapes, two policies
budgets.rationale: FR-R4-F12 FR-023: completion detection stays linear at 16 MiB. The median of 3 runs over each seeded shape is at most 1,500 ms at 16 MiB with a 16/8 MiB ratio of at most 3.0 (MAX_DOUBLING_RATIO). At plan the worst shape took 295.7 ms with a ratio of 2.4 (research R0). A deliberately quadratic reference scan must show a ratio above 3.0 on the same run shape, so the check can fail.

budgets.name: ArtifactLifecycleService.listInventory — warm page read at 10,000 artifacts, plus one 10,000-entry declared-root scan
budgets.rationale: FR-R6-F05 NFR-003 / SC-004 (AC-04): warm p95 of 200 measured page reads (20 warm-up, the F03 floor) at the 200-entry page bound is at most 500 ms, and the scan heap delta is at most 32 MiB (SCAN_HEAP_BUDGET_BYTES). One scan pass stops at SCAN_MAX_ENTRIES_PER_PASS (2,000) of the 10,000 entries and is asserted partial (NFR-001). At implement: p95 4.1 ms, scan heap delta 2.4 MiB (darwin-arm64, Node 24.19.0).

budgets.name: UsageAccountingService.query — warm filtered 200-row page read at 100,000 attempts with 4 measures each
budgets.rationale: FR-R6-F06 NFR-003 / SC-006: warm p95 of 200 measured filtered page reads (20 warm-up, the F03 floor, above the task's 5/50) grouped by phase at the 200-row page bound is at most 500 ms, and every response is at most 1 MiB. At implement: p95 399.3 ms, p99 428.4 ms, cold 387.7 ms, largest response 125,035 bytes (darwin-arm64, Node 24.19.0). Before idx_accounting_contributions_attempt the read was quadratic in store size and did not finish.

budgets.name: SpawnGate.admit — cached-identity admission through the wired gate
budgets.rationale: FR-R6-F09 NFR-001 / F09-AC-06: p95 of 200 measured admissions (20 warm-up, the F03 floor) from a cached version, with executable resolution, record and binding judgement and the per-Run check, is at most 10 ms. At implement: p95 0.235 ms (darwin-arm64, Node 24.19.0).

notes: All budgets are wall-clock milliseconds measured via performance.now().
Items 048 and 053 (deferred refactors) MAY adjust the StateProjector totals; reset budgets accordingly when those land.
Item 050 (second BackendRunner adapter, deferred) does not affect any budget.
